answer: Adaptive per-agent cost ridge: each agent maintains a rolling thread of its own past transactions; the protocol prices new volume against that thread’s median, charging a multiplier that climbs steeply above it and decays at a defined nadir over idle time. Splitting into many fresh agents hits the ridge immediately—each new identity pays the high multiplier on its first units, so N-way sybil fragmentation costs roughly N times a single honest agent’s marginal fee. Attackers must fund sustained overpayment across all shards or slow to the decay floor.
